column1: # Where the acceptance corpus's directory names come from.
# Every directory the acceptance run materialises is listed here with one of two
# provenances, and `go test ./acceptance/` checks both directions: a corpus
# directory that is not listed fails, and a listed name no corpus file uses fails.
#   library   a directory name copied verbatim from the owner's media library. The
#             listing this sample was drawn from is the old repository's
#             `acceptance/names-all.txt` (a directory listing of
#             /mnt/nova/data/media/downloads/completed/av on the TrueNAS host).
#             Directory names were copied, never cleaned: the brackets and the
#             full-width characters are the point. The file names inside them are the
#             corpus's own (see acceptance/corpus.go) — what this ledger records is
#             where each directory name came from.
#   boundary  written by hand for one rule's counterexample (the spec's own cases:
#             neighbours that must not merge, a duplicate stem, a conditional part
#             marker, two discs of one number). Not from the library, and it says so.
# name<TAB>provenance
